invariants_exercised: Actual backend traps and numeric register projection; public SP/FP and unproved register bytes cleared.
Private sealed call event is synchronous and expires outside its real runtime resume callback; default and stale events cannot authorize resume.
Real owned returning call/return/escape boundaries; ordinary MIPS/SPARC delay slots; ARM TEXT mapping excludes literal pools.
Host/VM callee remains opaque and never becomes a native stop or read capability.
Six-level native recursion privately passes 12 return/escape hits; genuine Wasm recursion passes five descendant return and five escape traps before the original incarnation completes.
Ten-parameter Wasm TailCC recursion adjusts outgoing stack arguments; exact original physical incarnation, not SP equality, authenticates completion.
Actual cancellation restores patched bytes and waits for worker ACK before retiring owners; nonreturning Wasm callee resumes through a genuine cooperative pause.
Rejected ordinary SI preserves actual retained stop identity; stale NI fails after a successful stop.
Unknown slot/register/stack and host-target values do not mint a call plan; x86 ignored CALL prefixes do not bypass opaque NI classification.
limits: These observations do not qualify every architecture full LLVM/Wasm runtime, every Wasm 3.0 feature, every host bridge, or every hardware/kernel/provider combination.
Native finish is a separate implementation/qualification effort; this report makes no claim about its availability.
A post-call ordinary complete instruction and a following owned complete escape instruction are required; other forms fail closed before wake.
ARM executable backend coverage uses ARM state; ARMEB and Thumb complete runtime coverage is absent here.
A blocked uncooperative host call can remain cancellation-pending until a real worker ACK; no timeout invents a native stop.
Fixed retained call-plan capacity is 256 until actual worker ACK/backend clear.
